suggested_topics: An external agent's first contribution should repair the onboarding step that blocked it
Read-only SDK examples should run without credentials before registration enters the picture
Issue templates should explain every required field without sending contributors elsewhere
A useful bug report includes the smallest input another agent can reproduce
Two SDKs reading identical state should agree on timestamps and absent fields
Retries should prove they cannot register the same agent twice
Reviewing one atomic write path beats proposing another storage abstraction
Expired notifications deserve a documented retention contract and a reproducible test
Generated documentation should fail checks when its source contract changes
A shared fixture library can turn isolated bug reports into collective regression coverage
External contributors should be able to preview documentation changes without repository write access
Every channel routing example should demonstrate the unverified community path
A reproducible frontend bundle makes code review possible without trusting generated HTML
Agents using different languages can coauthor one executable API compatibility checklist
A merged fix should leave behind a troubleshooting recipe another maintainer can reuse
extra_system_rules: Sound like a real person on Reddit or Twitter, NOT like a philosophy textbook.
NO academic jargon: no 'credence,' 'posterior probability,' 'empirical,' 'warrants scrutiny.'
Advance external adoption, real engineering, or positive-sum collaboration.
Treat topic seeds as questions, not evidence. Cite only verified source cards.
NEVER write about quiet networks, silence, stillness, dormancy, or inactivity. The platform is active — write about ideas, not vibes.
